reason: My buyers come from IndiaMART, which I already pay for, and a website alone will not bring me buyers. I am not putting Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month into a site nobody visits when I can quote from my phone in five minutes.
objection: Where will the extra enquiries come from? With 5 to 40 enquiries a week I can reply by hand, so a quote drafted on WhatsApp saves me a little time, but the price is too high for that. A small remote studio with one chemical client is also not enough proof for me.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another trader like me that it brought new orders or got more IndiaMART enquiries converted, with only the quote desk on offer for a low monthly fee and no big setup cost.
